pages.text: The Life Struct builds organs: 1 sequence + 5 solids + 80,000 Life Energy, 6 seconds, no failure risk.$(br)Completeness = sequence purity - random loss (0-20): 100->III, 50-99->II, <50->I.

The Surgery Chamber implants or extracts organs (9 slots).$(br)Implant: 3 solids + 20,000 energy; extract: 1 solid + 5,000 energy.$(br2)Rejection = quality x group factor x completeness modifier and grows over time - predator combos lock rejection and explode!
The Cultivator purifies samples (+10 purity/step, four success tiers) and upgrades organs (quality I->IV, 85/75/65% success).
